excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content:
So on the getBlobs API, there are a few possible semantics:
- give me all these or an error: useful now
- give me what you can of all these: useful only if we have cell-level messaging
- get me all these please: useful to trigger EL fetch

excerpts.author: cskiraly
excerpts.content:
So for blob tranmissions, there is before the block decision was made, and there is after.
- Before happens on EL, no question
- For the after, we could
   -  do nothing
   - do "expedited EL", 
   - do CL as we did in our DAS studies.
The time available is not different. What is different is how sources are made available in the system,  and what network stack we use.
